name: LATAM Cargo (2016 LATAM scheme)
description: The LATAM group scheme on a windowless freighter: white fuselage with 'LATAM' in bold indigo capitals over a light-weight indigo 'CARGO', the LATAM ribbon symbol ahead of them and a small Colombian flag behind the cockpit. An indigo wedge rises from the aft belly into the fin's root. Fin crossed by swept bands: a white tip with a small flag, a coral band, a broad indigo band, a short white and coral band pair running in from the trailing edge, a white band rising from the root's leading edge, and indigo below. White engines, indigo winglets.

areas.name: indigo wedge from the aft belly up into the fin's root, its lower edge rising to the tail cone under the tailplane
upper coral band, widest at the leading edge

white band rising from the root's leading edge into the lower coral band

titles.style: Wide, geometric bold capitals with even strokes, slightly tracked, behind the symbol over the forward fuselage; on the right side the same stretch, the symbol again at its forward end.
The same geometric capitals in a light weight, a little smaller, under LATAM and flush with its forward end.

logos.description: The LATAM symbol (as on the passenger scheme): a ribbon folding down in a zigzag, coral strips slanting down aft joined by indigo folds, ending in a short indigo stem; ahead of the titles, spanning both lines.
A small Colombian flag behind the cockpit windows, ahead of the forward door.
The same flag, small, in the white tip.

notes: LATAM Cargo Colombia flies 767-300 freighters (converted BCFs like N540LA, N542LA, N566LA and production 767-316Fs like N536LA) in the LATAM group scheme with 'LATAM CARGO' titles; all four photographed in 2026 match. Measured on N536LA (left, 2026-06-20): 'LATAM' runs x 0.183-0.318 with 1.4 m capitals, 'CARGO' 0.184-0.288 under it; the symbol is centred at x 0.152; the wedge's apex on the belly at x 0.754. The fin's bands were read against the photo's leading and trailing edges at each height (x as a share of the chord), since the shape's fin fitted ~15 px narrow; the right side shows the same bands mirrored. A small coral and indigo mark low on the forward fuselage under the titles (about 1.5 m wide) is left out: too small to read in these photos. The far wedge edge under the tailplane is seen only on N542LA (ground level): drawn ending on the tail cone at x 0.945. The registration country flags follow the registry (Colombia on these). Winglets look indigo from both sides, but the light makes the inner face uncertain.
history: New in the LAX round 2 (2026-11-20); LAE had no scheme here before (LATAM Cargo Chile, LCO, mapped to TAM/standard).
